title: A Generative Deep Learning Workflow for Inverse Molecular Design of Fuels
abstract: arXiv:2504.12075v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In the present work, a generative deep learning framework combining a Co-optimized Variational Autoencoder (Co-VAE) with quantitative structure-property relationship (QSPR) techniques is developed to enable inverse molecular design of fuels. The Co-VAE approach integrates an auxiliary fuel property prediction regression head with the VAE latent space, enhancing molecular reconstruction and accurate property estimation (Research Octane Number (RON) chosen as the fuel property of interest for demonstration studies). A subset of the GDB-13 database, combined with a curated RON database, is used for the Co-VAE training. Hyperparameter tuning is further utilized to optimize the balance among reconstruction fidelity, chemical validity, and RON prediction. Subsequently, an independent regression model is trained to further improve RON prediction accuracy, and a differential evolution algorithm is employed to efficiently navigate the Co-VAE

translated_title: 一种用于燃料逆向分子设计的生成式深度学习工作流
translated_abstract: 在本工作中，开发了一种结合协同优化变分自编码器（Co-VAE）与定量结构-性质关系（QSPR）技术的生成式深度学习框架，以实现燃料的逆向分子设计。Co-VAE方法将辅助燃料性质预测回归头与VAE潜在空间集成，增强了分子重建和准确性质估计（选择研究辛烷值（RON）作为演示研究的燃料性质）。使用GDB-13数据库的子集，结合精选的RON数据库，用于Co-VAE训练。进一步利用超参数调优来优化重建保真度、化学有效性和RON预测之间的平衡。随后，训练了一个独立的回归模型以进一步提高RON预测准确性，并采用差分进化算法高效导航Co-VAE潜在空间。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合Co-VAE和QSPR的生成式深度学习框架，用于燃料逆向分子设计，并通过差分进化算法优化潜在空间搜索，实现高精度性质预测和分子生成。
en_tdlr: This work proposes a generative deep learning framework combining Co-VAE and QSPR for inverse molecular design of fuels, utilizing differential evolution to efficiently search latent space for high-accuracy property prediction and molecular generation.
